verdict.rationale: HMRC documents a sanctioned software channel: Making Tax Digital filings must go through 'software that works with Making Tax Digital', and taxpayers have a published sign-up path. A live, versioned production REST API platform answers with a structured error contract, and a developer hub host exists. However, the developer documentation was not fetched because robots.txt blocks crawlers, so the software/vendor enrollment path is not evidenced. Missing for 10: published developer/application registration and credentialing path, system-account or batch-transmitter program documentation, API reference content, independent hands-on corroboration of software transacting end-to-end.
